name: darkhorse-pipeline
description: BR → FDS → TDS → Code pipeline for SAP RICEFW development

commands.title: DarkHorse: Start BR → FDS → TDS → Code Pipeline
DarkHorse: Load Reference Documents for This Project

darkhorse.pipeline.outputFolder.description: Local folder where FDS and TDS .docx files are saved

darkhorse.pipeline.referenceDocsFolder.description: Folder containing existing FDS/TDS documents for style reference

darkhorse.pipeline.defaultPackage.description: Default SAP package for generated objects

darkhorse.pipeline.llmProxyPort.description: Port of the DarkHorse LLM proxy (from MVP-5)

darkhorse.mcp.port.description: Port of the DarkHorse MCP knowledge server (services/darkhorse-mcp). The Code Agent calls this for Clean Core verification.

darkhorse.rag.azureSearchEndpoint.description: Azure AI Search endpoint URL for the RAG index (CPI-6 Sprint 2). Example: https://your-name.search.windows.net. When blank, the MCP server uses its built-in static catalogs only. The actual key is read from the AZURE_SEARCH_KEY environment variable for security.

darkhorse.rag.indexName.description: Azure AI Search index name for the DarkHorse RAG knowledge base.

darkhorse.rag.azureOpenAiEndpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL used by darkhorse-ingest to compute embeddings. Example: https://your-name.openai.azure.com. The key is read from AZURE_OPENAI_KEY env var. Not used by the extension itself at runtime; provided here for discoverability.

darkhorse.rag.embeddingDeployment.description: Name of the Azure OpenAI deployment hosting the embedding model. Must match the deployment created in the Azure portal.
